statement: Within the preregistered Round-3 same-class rocksalt and perovskite scope, the frozen multiplicative correction improved a0 median absolute relative error on the Round-3 out-of-sample candidates. Round 4 did not replicate this under its theorem-capped rule: a0 was not significant in either group (rocksalt ionics 5 improved and 2 worsened, two-sided sign-test p = 0.45; perovskites 4 improved and 0 worsened, p = 0.125). Part of the lattice-constant gain may absorb thermal-convention offsets between room- or high-temperature references and athermal predictions (errata 2026-07-13, item 9). This is a Round-3 result, not a public correction scope.

premises.statement: The confirmatory Round-3 out-of-sample evidence covers a0 corrections calibrated leave-one-out within the same structure class.

lean_theorem.reason: No Lean theorem proves the empirical Round-3 a0 improvement; the available capped in-hull theorems require stronger Round-4 caps and explicitly do not retroactively license the frozen Round-3 rule.

excluded_scope: Structures and chemistries outside the Round-3 rocksalt and perovskite evaluation sets
Round-4 out-of-sample candidates under the theorem-capped rule, where a0 improvement was not significant in either group
